notes.title: DEMO NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
Hey Steam Community!

We've got thrilling news for all you gamers out there! Our highly anticipated demo for Rebellion: Rise of the Damned is officially LIVE, and the best part? It's absolutely FREE for everyone to download and play right now!

Step into the captivating world of Rebellion: Rise of the Damned and experience a taste of the adventure that awaits. Whether you're a seasoned player or just looking for some adult-themed excitement, this demo is crafted just for YOU!

Ready to dive in? Head over to our Steam page, hit that download button, and let the adventure begin! Don't hesitate to share your thoughts, feedback, and memorable gaming moments with us in the comments. Your input is incredibly valuable to us!

Spread the word, rally your friends, and let's embark on this thrilling journey together! Let's create some gaming history!

See you in the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2902570/Rebellion_Rise_of_the_Damned/

notes.title: Developer Log: "Rebellion: The Beginning" Release
notes.notes:
Greetings, Steam Community!

We're thrilled to announce that the release of "Rebellion: The Beginning" is just on the horizon, scheduled for tomorrow! It's been an incredible journey full of hard work, passion, and dedication from our team, and we can't wait to share the fruits of our labor with you.

Release Date: Tomorrow!

We're beyond excited to bring "Rebellion: The Beginning" to life on the Steam platform. This game has been a labor of love, and we're immensely grateful for the support we've received from our community throughout its development.

A Heartfelt Thanks to Our Community

To everyone who has followed our progress, provided feedback, and supported us on this adventure, a sincere thank you. Your enthusiasm and encouragement have been our driving force, and we couldn't have come this far without you.

Stay Excited: "Rebellion: Rise Of The Damned" Teaser

As we celebrate the release of "Rebellion: The Beginning," we also want to share a little secret with you. We're already hard at work on the next chapter of the Rebellion saga - "Rebellion: Rise Of The Damned." The story continues, and new challenges await.

Stay excited for what's to come! We can't reveal too much just yet, but we promise it will be an adventure worth waiting for. The Rebellion is far from over, and we're eager to take you on the next thrilling journey.

Once again, thanks for your incredible support. Tomorrow, join us on Steam as "Rebellion: The Beginning" officially launches. And as you enjoy the beginning of this rebellion, keep an eye out for more news about the rise of the damned in our upcoming sequel.

Stay excited, stay tuned, and let the rebellion continue!

Warm regards,

AGHAMUS
